newsitem.title: BELGIUM: From bombing to barges - NATO's Claes gets new job.
newsitem.headline: From bombing to barges - NATO's Claes gets new job.

text.p: Willy Claes, the Belgian who resigned as secretary general of the NATO translantic alliance in October 1995 over a political bribery scandal, got a new job on Tuesday.
Claes, a former Belgian foreign minister and economics minister, was named by the Flemish regional government as the new head of inland shipping in the region.
As such Claes, once responsible for approving bombing raids on Serb positions in former Bosnia-Herzegovina, will have charge of 325 km (203 miles) of canals and waterways.
